parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the main switch plate of a wall switch, made of ABS plastic, typically rectangular and slightly convex for easy pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the user interface for toggling the electrical circuit on or off. It is designed to be pressed or flipped by the user.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pivoting or depressing slightly inward when pressed, returning to its original position via an internal spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or housing of the wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate material, providing structural support and insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the internal electrical components and provides a secure mounting surface for the switch plate. It also insulates and protects the wiring.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or electrical box, providing a stable base for the moving switch component.
